scope: Named state within the forward paper session, broker OMS, and swing paper book only. Different scopes are separate books and are not duplicate ownership.

authorities.note: Intents and simulated execution receipts are the durable source events; accounting status is rebuilt from them.
This is the local OMS journal; broker reconciliation remains a separate external observation.
This is a separate horizon-aware research/paper book, not the forward intraday OMS position store.

unresolved_domains.reason: Current accounting is a deterministic gross replay projection; it is not transactionally committed with the execution receipt/outbox and excludes statutory charges and financing.
Positions are rebuilt from intents and receipts rather than persisted as an atomic canonical position ledger.

duplicate_rule: At most one authoritative owner may exist for each (scope_id, domain). Separate books may each own similarly named state within their own scope.
